name: @scuttlarr/theme
description: The scuttlarr theme model — Omarchy's colors.toml palettes, derivation, template rendering, and the generator that bakes @scuttlarr/tui's built-in tokens. Pure TypeScript, no runtime deps.
//exports: './tokens' is the import-free ThemeTokens type: @scuttlarr/tui imports it without its typecheck crawling the parser (whose .ts specifiers need allowImportingTsExtensions).
